Name: Key-VisualArt's music replacement (Read the README)
Author: Sarsayogor
Description:
A seasonal soundtrack overhaul that replaces Stardew Valley’s music with iconic tracks from visual novels by [b]Key/Visual Arts[/b]:
[i]Rewrite (spring)[/i], [i]AIR (summer)[/i], [i]Clannad / Little Busters! (autumm)[/i], [i]Kanon (winter)[/i].
[line]🎧 Features[list]
[*]Replaces [b]seasonal music[/b] with tracks from their corresponding Key VN:
[list]
[*][b]Spring[/b] → [i]Rewrite[/i]
[*][b]Summer[/b] → [i]AIR[/i]
[*][b]Fall[/b] → [i]Clannad[/i] & [i]Little Busters![/i]
[*][b]Winter[/b] → [i]Kanon[/i]
[/list][*]Includes unique themes for:
[list]
[*][b]Festivals[/b]
[*][b]Weather and ambient effects[/b]
[*][b]Menus and locations[/b] (saloon, title screen, farmhouse at night, etc.)
[*][b]Mines[/b] (Earth/Frost/Lava levels)
[/list][*]Seamlessly integrated using [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]SMAPI[/b].
[/list][line]💾 Installation[list=1]
[*][b]Install[/b] SMAPI and Content Patcher.

[*]Extract the contents of this mod to your [code]Mods[/code] folder.

[*]⚠️ Due to copyright reasons, the music files must be downloaded [b]separately[/b]:
[list]
[*]Follow the instructions in the included [code]README.txt[/code].
[/list]
[/list][line]🎵 Replaced TracksSee [code]README.txt[/code] for the full tracklist with sources and song titles.
[line]    - Credit[list]
[*]Original music by [b]Key/Visual Arts[/b].
[*]Inspired by the works of [b]Jun Maeda[/b] and the talented composers from [i]Key Sounds Label[/i].
[*]Mod assembled by the community for personal use and appreciation.
[/list]
